citations.assessment: The primary source confirms the fraternity and Menaḥem's transmission in Ammi’s name. The patronymic in the checked Yerushalmi is Makhsima, while Heilprin has Mevasima.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
